The reference also reaches t, so J_r(t) <= k_ref(r) and T_ceiling >= 0, equal to 0 where the reference workload is itself the joint design at some reading. Each test prints T_ceiling. A test with T_ceiling <= 0 cannot read beyond the noise and one with T_ceiling < 0.05 cannot meet the size floor whatever the other members cost: it is named BLOCKED (reference-anchor identity), keeps its p in BH and is not confirmed. On the exploratory reading the identity blocks none of the 36 (ceilings 0.32 to 5.69); t_nt, where it blocked all 105 determinable declared comparisons, is not in the family (AC-2). With the band, S_r(t - 55) is at most S on G-ref's own geometry, so T stays at most T_ceiling; for the energy tests the ceiling takes its leakage form (declared.leakage_at_its_worst_G4_C2).
